vanilla_merged_tableau.interpretation: Merged-ABox Tableau detects contradiction existence but cannot localize whether the clash was already present inside a perspective; intra contradictions are attributed to the merged/inter scope.

scope_ablation.note: Controlled capability ablation. The improvement is for four-way contradiction-scope classification, not generic SAT detection or natural-language generalization. Rashomon does not alter the class decision in this ablation.

explanation_ablation.note: Controlled cases contain two independent minimal contradictions per case: hierarchy-mediated and inverse-mediated. A single-proof output covers one of two minimal explanations, while Rashomon enumeration retains both.
